# KRUPA ELEVATORS

> Elevator manufacturer in Kathwada GIDC, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Designs, manufactures, installs and maintains passenger, home (villa), capsule (panoramic glass), hospital (stretcher), goods (freight), car (parking), MRL (machine-room-less) and hydraulic elevators, with factory-direct pricing and monopoly-free AMC (annual maintenance contracts).

- Website: https://krupaelevators.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 82008 59171
- Email: info@krupaelevators.com, sales@krupaelevators.com
- Manufacturing works: 1, Heritage Industrial Hub, Nr. Global Industrial Estate, Nr. Kotak Mahindra Bank, Kathwada GIDC Road No 5, Ahmedabad-382430, Gujarat, India
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 09:00 to 20:00 IST
- Service area: Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar, Vadodara, Surat, Rajkot and across Gujarat and India
- Product brochure (PDF): https://krupaelevators.com/assets/krupa-brochure.pdf

## Company

- [KRUPA ELEVATORS | Elevator Manufacturer in Ahmedabad](https://krupaelevators.com/): Factory-direct passenger, home, goods, hospital & MRL elevators from our Kathwada GIDC plant. Installation, modernization & AMC across Gujarat.

## Services

- [Services & AMC Maintenance | KRUPA ELEVATORS](https://krupaelevators.com/services): Elevator installation, monopoly-free AMC, modernization and 24/7 emergency support across Ahmedabad and Gujarat from Krupa Elevators.
- [Elevator AMC & Maintenance in Ahmedabad | KRUPA ELEVATORS](https://krupaelevators.com/services/amc-maintenance): Monopoly-free elevator AMC in Ahmedabad: non-proprietary controllers, no locked passwords, certified technicians, genuine spares and 24/7 breakdown support.
- [Elevator Modernization & Retrofitting | KRUPA ELEVATORS](https://krupaelevators.com/services/modernization): Upgrade aging elevators with V3F drives, microprocessor controllers, automatic doors and new cabin interiors, without rebuilding the existing hoistway.
- [Elevator Installation & Commissioning Process | KRUPA ELEVATORS](https://krupaelevators.com/services/installation): Our elevator installation process, from requirement consultation and building survey through manufacturing, on-site erection and statutory commissioning.
- [24/7 Emergency Elevator Breakdown Support | KRUPA ELEVATORS](https://krupaelevators.com/services/emergency-support): 24/7 elevator breakdown support with a 30-45 minute response guarantee across Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar and Sanand/Bavla, using genuine spare parts.
